title: Eat Like A Greek!
description: This mod adds greek food thats all.
body:
This mod adds greek mod to the game!



Added Food:



• Gyros: Use a cooked porkchop with a bread to make gyros!

• Bougatsa: Use eggs, sugar, milk, wheat and a bowl to make bougatsa!

• Souvlaki: Use 3 sticks and a cooked chicken to make souvlaki!



This mod also adds some advancements by eating these foods!
